AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.

Review and potentially reconfigure AI strategies to ensure they are actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies to ensure they are correctly implemented and aligned with market conditions.
